program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "I1":    (28e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),  # current per pair device (tail = 2*I1)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS load L
    "C2":    (0.4e-12, 0.25e-12, 1.0e-12),  # SK grounded cap
    "q":     (0.68, 0.60, 0.72),     # design Q (below 0.707 to absorb finite-GBW Q boost)
    "rr":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # R1/R2 ratio (big R1 -> less output feedthrough)
    "fct":   (1.5e6, 1.44e6, 1.56e6) # target -3 dB frequency
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    I1 = p["I1"]

    # OTA: NMOS diff pair 5T, unity-gain follower
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, 2 * I1, vds=0.3)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    rout = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A0 = gm1 * rout

    # Sallen-Key unity gain sizing
    q = p["q"]; r = p["rr"]
    C2 = p["C2"]
    n_c = q * q * (1 + r) ** 2 / r
    C1 = n_c * C2
    a = 1 - 1 / (2 * q * q)
    kfc = math.sqrt(a + math.sqrt(a * a + 1))
    f0 = p["fct"] / kfc
    w0 = 2 * PI * f0
    c2_par = 0.3 * m1.cgg
    C2_place = max(C2 - c2_par, 0.1e-12)
    R2 = 1.0 / (w0 * math.sqrt(r * C1 * C2))
    R1 = r * R2

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "x", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R1)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "x", R2)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "x", "vss", C2_place)

    cout = cl + C1 + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    q_eff = q * (1 + 2 * q * f0 / gbw * 0.5)
    if q_eff > 1 / math.sqrt(2):
        pk = 20 * math.log10(q_eff / math.sqrt(1 - 1 / (4 * q_eff ** 2)))
    else:
        pk = 0.0
    fc = p["fct"]
    x = 10 * fc / f0
    h = 1 / math.sqrt((1 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / q) ** 2)
    zout = 1 / (2 * PI * 10 * fc * cout)
    ff = zout / R1
    atten = -20 * math.log10(h + ff)
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(A0 / (1 + A0))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + 2 * I1)

    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": pk,
               "power": power, "gain_db": gain_db}
